_doc: machine mod (Machine) settings. Override any key with your own JSON file (userConfig 'config', deep merge; keys starting with _ are ignored). Nothing is sampled while the pane is closed and the band entry is off.
_min_interval_s: floor applied to interval_s and band.interval_s, so a typo cannot poll faster
_families: process name (without .exe) equal to an entry, or the entry followed by a non-letter (git-remote-https, python3.14)

gpu._source: auto: nvidia-smi, else the Windows performance counter below (typeperf), else 'non disponible'. nvidia-smi | perf | off force one.

ci._doc: GitLab runner load through the ci mod's own scanner and config (mods/ci): same status cache, same token rules (presence only). Empty scanner = the ci mod next to this one.

advice._doc: agents en parallèle conseillés = base + the delta of the FIRST matching rule of each metric, then each cap, then clamped to [floor, ceiling]. Metrics: cpu, ram (%), gpu (% max), disk_free_gb (lowest fixed drive), ci_running, ci_pending (jobs of the backends above), runner_children (jobs the local runner process is running, non vérifié). A metric that could not be read skips its rules.

rules.label: moins de 10 Go libres sur un disque

caps.label: 4 pipelines CI au plus (moins les jobs en cours)
3 npm ci / tsc en même temps au plus

band._doc: Compact entry above the prompt, off by default (userConfig 'band'). Items in order: advice, cpu, ram, gpu, disk, ci.

levels._doc: colour of a % reading: >= bad is bad, >= warn is warn
